functionDeclarations.name: list_exercises
functionDeclarations.description: List the exercises the user has logged, with session counts, last date and muscle group. Optional query filters by name substring or muscle group (e.g. 'Back').

functionDeclarations.name: get_exercise_history
functionDeclarations.description: Recent sessions for one exercise (newest first): date, every set, top set and estimated 1RM.

functionDeclarations.name: get_personal_records
functionDeclarations.description: Personal records. With an exercise: best e1RM, heaviest top set and biggest-volume session. Without: the user's strongest lifts ranked by e1RM.

functionDeclarations.name: get_workouts
functionDeclarations.description: Full workouts (all exercises and sets) grouped by day, newest first, optionally within a YYYY-MM-DD date range. Use for 'what did I do on/last ...' questions.

functionDeclarations.name: get_training_summary
functionDeclarations.description: Training overview for the last N days: workouts per week, gaps, volume, weekly sets per muscle group, most trained exercises and neglected muscle groups.

functionDeclarations.name: get_progress_trend
functionDeclarations.description: Strength trend for one exercise over N days: first vs latest e1RM, % change, kg/week trend line, all-time best and whether progress looks stalled.

functionDeclarations.name: review_lifts
functionDeclarations.description: Progress check on every lift trained regularly in the last N days (default 180, at least 90) in one call: per lift first/latest e1RM, % change, kg/week trend, all-time best and looks_stalled. Stalled lifts come first, each with its next-session target (weight and reps). Use it for 'what's stalling / progressing / how are my lifts'.

functionDeclarations.name: compare_periods
functionDeclarations.description: Compare the last N days with the N days before: workout days, sets, volume, best e1RM. Optionally for one exercise.

functionDeclarations.name: suggest_next_session
functionDeclarations.description: Concrete target for the next session of one exercise (weight and reps per set) using double progression against the user's rep range. Use for 'what should I aim for/lift next time'.

functionDeclarations.name: get_plan
functionDeclarations.description: The user's workout plan text and when each workout title was last done. Use for 'what should I train today' and programming questions.
